note.question: How does an integer program contribute to modifying bandit learning strategies by constraining the action space up front?
note.overview: This paper studies personalized product recommendations on platforms when customers have unknown preferences. Importantly, customers may disengage when offered poor recommendations. Online platforms often personalize product recommendations using bandit algorithms, which balance an exploration-exploitation trade-off.
